title: Implement --watch mode in StatusDashboard
description: Add auto-refresh support to StatusDashboard. Re-reads all data sources every 5 seconds and re-renders. Press 'q' to exit. Clears interval on unmount.
acceptanceCriteria: When tasks.json is modified during watch, the dashboard updates on next refresh
Interval is cleared when component unmounts

steps.description: Add watch mode state refresh to StatusDashboard
steps.details: When watch prop is true, add useEffect: const interval = setInterval(async () => { const tasks = await readTasks(agentDir); const stats = calculateProgress(tasks); const activity = await readRecentActivity(agentDir); setStats(stats); setActivity(activity); }, 5000); return () => clearInterval(interval)

steps.description: Add 'q' to exit in watch mode
steps.details: const { exit } = useApp(); useInput((input) => { if (options.watch && input === 'q') exit() })

technicalNotes: setInterval in useEffect must return the clearInterval cleanup function to prevent memory leaks and multiple intervals on re-render
